description: **Breaking: every destructive command now asks before it runs, and `--verbose`/`--dry-run` moved to the CLI framework.** `delete`, `undelete` and `purge` are classified mutating: they prompt on a terminal and refuse with `error: stdin is not interactive; pass --yes to confirm` where there is none, so scripts and agents must write `saferm --yes delete --description "why" <files>`. `list` and `info` are read-only and never ask. The four framework flags (`--quiet`, `--verbose`, `--dry-run`, `--yes`) are now recognized anywhere on the command line and have no short forms.
